name: To My Only Desire
source:
The unicorn is a chaste creature of God. They are elusive wonders which only exist in whispers and rare sightings, although those who claim to have conquered the beast tell of its extraordinary abilities to heal, to purify, to detect poison.

An esteemed household of noble hunters is unable to capture this highly sought prize for decades, as a virgin maiden is needed to soothe the creature into compliance. The rare birth of a female heir, however, finally provides an opportunity to seize the beast.

Thus begins the unicorn's entrapment. Will her captor take pity upon the creature, or is this beast nothing more than a trophy to be won?

[From [url=https://rabbitbrew.itch.io/to-my-only-desire]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
独角兽是上帝麾下贞洁无瑕的圣兽。它们行踪缥缈，只存在于世人的耳语传说与寥寥无几的目击轶闻之中；不过据那些宣称曾降服过此兽的人所言，独角兽拥有治愈伤痛、净化污秽与探查剧毒的非凡神力。

某户声名显赫的贵族猎人世家数十年来始终未能捕获这一梦寐以求的猎物，只因唯有纯洁的处女方能安抚独角兽令其驯服。直到家族罕见地诞下一名女性继承人，捕获圣兽的良机终于降临。

诱捕独角兽的计划就此展开。俘获它的少女究竟会对这头生灵动起怜悯之心，还是仅将其视作一件待夺的战利品？

[摘自[url=https://rabbitbrew.itch.io/to-my-only-desire]itch.io[/url]]
